triggers.name: The Shadow has no camps left

actions.text: The last camp of the Shadow is broken. The War of the Ring is won.
The muster of the realms — every camp musters more.
The riding of the hosts — every camp musters more.
The last debate — every camp musters more.
Your camps muster armies on their own. Throw down every camp the enemy holds — nothing else wins.
